lead: After `wsl --shutdown`, `tools/nv/cmd/db-matrix.ts` fails at `docker compose up` with `500 Internal Server Error` on `dockerDesktopLinuxEngine/_ping`, and its message says only that the daemon may be unreachable.
body: Docker Desktop's processes stay up while its engine sits at `stopping`, so nothing restarts it on its own. Run `docker desktop status`, and if it says `stopping`, `docker desktop restart` brings the engine back in under a minute.
